name: Symbiote Supreme

abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Direct Damage: Zırh ve dirençleri yok sayan doğrudan hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Stagger: Sendeletilen (Staggered) şampiyonlar bir sonraki kazandıkları buff'ı Nullify eder.
abilityDetails.Protection: Tüm kaynaklardan alınan hasarı belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Perfect Block: Bloklarken gelen tüm hasarı sıfıra indirir.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Power Steal: Hedefin gücünü azaltıp aynı miktarı kendine kazandırır.
abilityDetails.Weakness: Saldırı gücünü düşürür; sıfırın altına inemez.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.

signatureAbility:
Symbiomancy
Every [20 - 10] seconds place a Stagger Passive effect on the Opponent, lasting 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Symbiote Supreme gains 100% less power from Attacking, Blocking, and being Struck. But gains 16.5% of his Max Power every 9 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Genetic Potential - Passive
content: Each time a Buff or a Stagger effect on the Opponent ends gain 25 Genetic Potential, to a maximum of 100.
Gain an additional 50 Genetic Potential if a Buff ends due to a Nullify or Stagger effect.

abilitySections.title: Genetic Blessings - Passive
content: Symbiote Supreme can manifest 3 different Genetic Blessings, every 15 seconds he switches to the next in the following order: Chthon's Cunning, Null's Shadow, and Set's Fangs.
Each time a Blessing triggers 100% of Genetic Potential is consumed to gain up to 100% of a Bar of Power.

abilitySections.title: Chthon's Cunning - Passive
content: 100% chance when this blessing is triggered to immediately Nullify all Buffs off the Opponent.
[6,164.6] Direct Damage is Passively dealt to the Opponent for each Buff Nullified, based on Genetic Potential.
While active gain a 5% chance to place a Stagger Passive on the Opponent lasting 10 seconds on each Basic Attack Hit. Critical Hits increase the Chance to 50%.

abilitySections.title: Null's Shadow - Passive
content: 100% chance when this Blessing is triggered to gain a Protection Buff preventing Symbiote Supreme from taking more than 15% of his Max Health per hit, lasting for 10 seconds. This Protection threshold is reduced by 50% if the Opponent has an active Buff.
[1,833.33] Armor and 40% chance to Perfect Block as a Passive effect, based on Genetic Potential.

While active gain a 15% chance to place a Stagger Passive on the Opponent lasting 10 seconds each time Symbiote Supreme is Struck by or Blocks the Opponent. Well timed blocks increase the Chance to 50%.

abilitySections.title: Set's Fangs - Passive
content: 100% chance when this Blessing is triggered to gain a Fury Buff increasing Attack by up to [9,721.1] for 10 Seconds, based on Genetic Potential.
100% chance to cause a Bleed Debuff on every Hit, dealing up to [8,061.4] Direct Damage based on Genetic Potential and lasting 8 seconds.
Each hit of a Special Attack gains a 50% chance to place a Stagger Passive on the Opponent lasting 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 100% Chance to Nullify 1 Buff. Gain 50 Genetic Potential if a Buff is Nullified.
Switch to the next Blessing.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: While Chthon's Cunning is active each hit has a 100% chance to steal 15% of the Opponent's Max Power.
While Null's Shadow is active each hit has a 100% chance to place a Weakness Debuff on the Opponent reducing their Attack by 33% for 10 seconds.
While Set's Fangs is active each hit has a 100% chance to place an Armor Break Debuff on the Opponent reducing their Armor by [2,750] for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to reset the Genetic Blessing timer, and activate all 3 Genetic Blessings.
+100 Genetic Potential.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Symbiomancy
content: Every [20 - 10] seconds place a Stagger Passive effect on the Opponent, lasting 10 seconds.
